subject: Mental Models
title: Boundaries and Bottlenecks
description: A quick win: understand Boundaries and Bottlenecks.

hook.text: A highway has ten lanes but narrows to three at a tunnel. The tunnel's capacity sets the speed for the entire highway.

buildup.text: Every system has a bottleneck: the narrowest point that limits overall throughput no matter how fast the rest runs.

discovery.text: Goldratt's Theory of Constraints says improving anything except the bottleneck is waste. Only the constraint matters.

twist.text: Fix one bottleneck and another appears. Systems always have a constraint.

climax.text: Find the constraint first. Pour all resources there. Once it is fixed, find the new constraint and repeat.

punchline.text: Speed up the bottleneck. Everything else is noise.

quiz.question: According to Goldratt, where should you focus improvement efforts?
options: On the fastest part of the system
Only on the bottleneck that limits overall throughput
